# Public test certificates

Generated 2026-10-23 with OpenSSL 3.6.4 solely as public test fixtures. Both
private keys are deliberately public and must never be used for deployment.
The CA private key is discarded. Root/leaf certificates use P-256 ECDSA;
server.pem has localhost and 127.0.0.1 SANs and serverAuth EKU. The 10-year
validity is for reproducible local tests; certificate time checks remain enabled.

`server-sec1-key.pem` is the same public test key as `server-key.pem`, converted
with `openssl ec -in server-key.pem -out server-sec1-key.pem`. Both encodings
are covered by TLS handshake and signing equivalence regressions; the independent
OpenSSL client test uses the SEC1 key.

`p384-sec1-key.pem` is a deliberately public wrong-curve negative fixture
generated by `openssl ecparam -name secp384r1 -genkey -noout`.
